about_the_game:
The Mirror's Curse is a first-person escape-room puzzle game with a mysterious, action-packed twist. Trapped in limbo — a distorted version of your own home — you must solve intricate mirror puzzles, navigate maze-like rooms, and outsmart vengeful spirits to break free.

The mirrors are your greatest mystery and danger: while they reveal hidden clues, staring too long raises your curse level, triggering supernatural attacks.

Can you break free from the curse, or will you remain trapped in this haunting realm?

  • Engaging Puzzle Mechanics:

    Solve a range of intricate puzzles using clues hidden throughout the house. From deciphering codes to manipulating objects in specific orders, each puzzle draws you deeper into the mystery.

  • Curse and Mirror Mechanic:

    Mirrors reveal clues and secrets that help solve puzzles, but staring too long raises your curse level. As your curse level rises, supernatural phenomena become more intense, leading to dangerous encounters and paranormal attacks.

  • Hidden Secrets:

    Discover hidden rooms and paths, many only accessible through solving specific puzzles. Each area contains lore items and fragments that reveal the story of your character's past.

  • Immersive Experience:

    With atmospheric sound design, eerie visuals, and a realistic art style, every corner of the limbo house holds surprises and the unsettling fear of the unknown.

  • Estimated Playtime:

    30–60 minutes. Perfect for players seeking a short, engaging puzzle experience with a mystical atmosphere.

content_descriptors.notes: WARNING: This game explores dark themes and includes visual depictions of death and self-harm. Some scenes may be disturbing to players. Discretion is advised.
